verdict.rationale: Docs confirm real-time balances/transaction data (unit-docs-1, unit-docs-12) and a dedicated Webhook Events API page (unit-docs-25), indicating an event-driven ledger with webhook support. However, the pack lacks specifics on how holds/pending activity are reflected in balance reads or a breakdown of which transaction state changes trigger webhooks. missing for 10: detailed documentation on hold/pending balance semantics, enumerated webhook event types per transaction state, and independent/hands-on confirmation of webhook reliability.
